title: Stochastic Knothe-Rosenblatt: Light-speed Calibration of Stochastic Local Volatility Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.39256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: European option smiles determine the risk-neutral marginal laws of an asset, but not their intertemporal coupling, which is decisive for many applications. The Bass martingale construction selects, among all calibrated martingales, the one closest to Bachelier dynamics; it permits fast calibration at discrete maturities and recovers the Dupire local-volatility (LV) model as the maturity grid is refined.   This article develops a modular calibration overlay for existing stochastic and path-dependent volatility models. We recursively construct a martingale that matches all prescribed marginals exactly while remaining as close as possible, in an adapted Knothe-Rosenblatt sense, to the reference dynamics. As with the Bass LV model, each calibration step is amenable to an efficient Martingale Sinkhorn algorithm. translated_title: 随机Knothe-Rosenblatt方法：随机局部波动率模型的光速校准
translated_abstract: 欧式期权微笑曲线决定了资产的风险中性边际分布，但无法确定其跨期耦合关系，而后者对许多应用具有决定性意义。Bass鞅构造在所有经校准的鞅中选取最接近Bachelier动态的一个；它支持在离散到期点上进行快速校准，并且随着到期时间网格的细化可恢复出Dupire局部波动率（LV）模型。本文为现有的随机波动率与路径依赖波动率模型开发了一种模块化的校准叠加方法。我们递归地构造一个鞅，该鞅在一种适配的Knothe-Rosenblatt意义下精确匹配所有给定的边际分布，同时尽可能贴近参考动态。与Bass LV模型一样，每个校准步骤均可采用高效的鞅Sinkhorn算法。我们建立了该方法的理论基础与数值实现，并考察了向SLV模型的收敛性，同时对该方法进行了基准测试。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于递归Knothe-Rosenblatt鞅构造的模块化校准叠加方法，结合高效的鞅Sinkhorn算法，可在保持贴近参考动态的同时精确匹配给定期权微笑边际分布，从而实现对随机局部波动率模型的超快速校准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modular calibration overlay based on a recursive Knothe-Rosenblatt martingale construction, which uses the efficient Martingale Sinkhorn algorithm to exactly match prescribed option-smile marginals while staying as close as possible to the reference dynamics, enabling light-speed calibration of stochastic local volatility models.
